items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The first time I heard Basie in person he knocked my head off, but Don Byas was there.

ctx.x: But, you got to hear Basie obviously say with, Lester Young and that era of players.

I didn’t get to hear him with Lester when he was first in the band ‘cause he left about the time I became – he left in 1941 and I never heard him then. The first time I heard Basie in person he knocked my head off, but Don Byas was there.
